# tenure place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenurePlace`](gmeow-tenurePlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenurePlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The place (parcel, lot, or spatial unit) over which the rights of this [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) apply. Functional: a tenure concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single place (parcel, lot, spatial unit) a land tenure applies over; functional, constitutive of identity.

### Avoid when

- Avoid multiple places per tenure (mint one per place).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:tenurePlace`](gmeow-tenurePlace.md) per [`LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md).
